rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something relating to mathematics, such as a mathematical problem.

example.english: This mathematical problem is really quite difficult.
example.traditional: 呢條數學題真係幾難喎。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 sou3 hok6 tai4 zan1 hai6 gei2 naan4 wo3

rows.note: Use this for something extremely exact or precise rather than something merely related to mathematics.

example.english: The mathematical calculation is extremely precise and has no errors at all.
example.traditional: 佢度尺寸度得好精準，完全冇差錯。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dok6 cek3 cyun3 dok6 dak1 hou2 zing1 zeon2 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 caa1 co3

rows.note: Use this when something is technically possible but the chance of it happening is very small.

example.english: Given this traffic, the mathematical odds of him arriving on time are very small.
example.traditional: 以而家咁塞車，佢準時到嘅機會好微。
example.jyutping: ji5 ji4 gaa1 gam3 sak1 ce1 keoi5 zeon2 si4 dou3 ge3 gei1 wui6 hou2 mei4
